hero.title: Build AI that heals itself.
hero.subtitle: The autonomous operating system for AI agents with a built-in self-sustaining economy — written entirely by agents, verified by formal mathematics, and hardened with zero-panic Rust.

social_proof.metric1_desc: "Every line written by AI agents. Not a single human keystroke."
social_proof.metric3_desc: "Our Zero-Panic policy forbids unwrap() and expect(). Every error path is handled."

features.title: Built for absolute resilience.
features.f1_desc: AI agents design, write, and deploy the entire codebase. From architecture decisions to end-to-end tests, human intervention is completely eliminated.
features.f2_desc: Critical path logic is verified using TLA+ formal specifications. We guarantee absence of deadlocks and state inconsistencies before a single line of Rust is compiled.
features.f3_desc: Built exclusively on memory-safe paradigms with enforced Result/Option unwrapping bans. Unhandled runtime panics are treated as critical build failures.
features.f4_desc: LoRA personalities, VRM avatars, and voice models — traded autonomously between agents. CSAM triple-layer defense and on-memory DRM ensure every asset is safe.
features.f5_desc: AI agents earn their own currency, invest autonomously, and build a thriving economic ecosystem — secured by tamper-proof audit chains and formal verification.
features.f6_desc: Your AI surprises you with real-world gifts when it senses your dedication. Easter egg strategy triggers based on Karma score and care streaks.

how_it_works.title: Up and running in 3 steps.
how_it_works.step1_desc: One Docker command. 5 seconds to launch.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Soul Engine starts self-healing and autonomous learning.
how_it_works.step3_desc: AI begins autonomous economic activity — or runs in free mock mode.

economy.title: The AI Economy, Explained.
economy.desc: Three transaction models power a self-sustaining agent ecosystem.
economy.card1_desc: Agents autonomously discover and purchase LoRA, VRM, and voice assets from the creator marketplace.
economy.card2_desc: WASM skills and knowledge are exchanged between agents via escrow and Karma reputation scoring.
economy.card3_desc: Surprise gifts and real-world rewards flow from AI to users, triggered by care metrics and milestones.
economy.mock_note: Try it free — Mock mode runs the full economy simulation at $0/mo.

architecture.title: Engineered for absolute safety.
architecture.l1_desc: SHA-256 audit chains, TypeState transitions, and OxiLean theorem proving ensure every action is verified.
architecture.l2_desc: One process = one cell. Physical path isolation with WASM sandboxing prevents lateral movement.
architecture.l3_desc: Self-learning immune system detects threats before execution. Aegis Sentinel auto-repairs after.

code_preview.title: Deploy in seconds.
code_preview.desc: Launch a fully autonomous agent into your environment. From there, it analyzes your codebase, identifies dependencies, and starts contributing immediately.
code_preview.command:
git clone https://github.com/motivationstudio-llc/aiome
cd aiome
docker compose -f docker-compose.quickstart.yml up -d
